content:
RADIOLOGY REPORT

Patient: Jane Doe, MRN 778421, DOB 04/12/1958
Study: CT Chest, Abdomen and Pelvis with IV contrast (arterial, portal venous and delayed phases)
Date: 2026-04-18

CLINICAL INDICATION
Newly diagnosed pancreatic adenocarcinoma on EUS-guided biopsy. Staging study. No prior imaging available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE
Multiphase contrast-enhanced CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis following 100 mL of intravenous Omnipaque 350. Arterial, portal venous and 5-minute delayed phases through the abdomen. Multiplanar reformats reviewed.

FINDINGS

Pancreas:
There is an ill-defined hypoenhancing mass centred on the pancreatic head and uncinate process measuring 38 x 32 x 30 mm (longest axial diameter 38 mm). The mass demonstrates an irregular, spiculated margin with infiltration of the surrounding peripancreatic fat. The lesion abuts the superior mesenteric artery over approximately 160 degrees of its circumference and encases the superior mesenteric vein with a short-segment narrowing. Findings consistent with locally advanced disease and vascular involvement.

Biliary system:
Marked intra- and extrahepatic biliary ductal dilatation secondary to obstruction at the level of the pancreatic head mass. The common bile duct measures 18 mm. No biliary stent in situ.

Liver:
Multiple hypoenhancing lesions are scattered throughout both lobes, in keeping with hepatic metastases. The largest, in segment VII, measures 28 mm in longest diameter and is designated a RECIST target lesion. A further metastasis in segment IV measures 15 mm. Additional sub-centimetre lesions are present but not separately measured. The lesions are solid with central low attenuation suggesting early necrosis. Margins are circumscribed.

Lymph nodes:
Enlarged retroperitoneal lymph node in the aortocaval station measures 14 mm in short axis, considered pathological and metastatic in this context.

Bones:
A lytic lesion is present in the L3 vertebral body measuring 22 mm, with no associated soft tissue component or cortical breach. In keeping with skeletal metastasis.

Kidneys:
Simple cortical cyst in the lower pole of the right kidney measuring 16 mm, of fluid attenuation, with no enhancing component. Benign.

Chest:
Small left-sided pleural effusion. No pulmonary nodules. No mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy.

Other:
No ascites. Spleen, adrenal glands and remainder of bowel unremarkable.

IMPRESSION
1. Locally advanced pancreatic head adenocarcinoma with SMA abutment and SMV encasement (cT4).
2. Multiple hepatic metastases and a single retroperitoneal nodal metastasis (cM1, cN1).
3. Lytic L3 vertebral metastasis.
4. Malignant biliary obstruction.
5. Incidental simple right renal cyst. Small left pleural effusion.

Overall stage: cT4 N1 M1 — AJCC Stage IV.

output.report_summary: Staging CT for newly diagnosed pancreatic head adenocarcinoma demonstrates locally advanced primary with SMA abutment and SMV encasement, multiple hepatic metastases, retroperitoneal nodal metastasis and a lytic L3 vertebral metastasis (cT4 N1 M1, AJCC Stage IV). Malignant biliary obstruction. Incidental simple right renal cyst and small left pleural effusion.
